% A guard, for files of the document named like a .4ht file: one named
% like the glossaries package, read with \input before
% \usepackage{glossaries}, with hyperref. As in the PDF, the file's text
% is in the page, and the term links to its entry in the glossary.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\input{glossaries.ltx}
\usepackage{glossaries}
\makenoidxglossaries
\newglossaryentry{ring}{name={ring},
  description={a set with two operations}}
\begin{document}
\section{Rings}
A \gls{ring}. \ownglossaries
\printnoidxglossaries
\end{document}
